name: ElegantFin TV
description: Minimal ElegantFin design with native Jellyfin motion and Media Bar focus support. Requires a compatible File Transformation plugin. LG C4 integration still requires on-device verification.

versions.changelog: Match Jelly+ seasonal recommendations to regular ElegantFin poster sizes, spacing, corners and responsive breakpoints. Keep 2:3 artwork and truncate long titles without widening the page. Document that missing modern-client actions require Jelly+ support.

overview: ElegantFin for webOS and TV layouts
